meta.name: tfx-remote
meta.description: 원격 관련 표면을 setup/spawn 계열 하나로 통합한 엔트리포인트. setup, spawn, list, attach, send, resume, kill, probe 하위 명령을 기준으로 기존 tfx-remote-setup/tfx-remote-spawn 흐름을 축소 통합한다.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统一管理远程开发环境,快速创建、连接和操作会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常在远程服务器上工作、需要高效管理多个开发环境
copy.tagline_en: Manage remote dev environments with unified commands for setup, attach, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly work on remote servers and need to manage multiple dev sessions

howto.what: Claude 会把远程主机和会话管理收进 tfx-remote 这一组命令:登记/编辑/诊断主机,创建/列出/附加/发送/恢复/终止会话,并检查 SSH、Tailscale、Claude 连接。
howto.when: 当用户要求登记或诊断远程主机、新建或恢复远程会话,或对会话发后续消息时,会进入该技能。

say.text: 用 tfx-remote spawn 在 host1 上新建会话
say.note: 会先做 preflight,再创建会话。
恢复最近会话;没有则按 default_host 新建。
进入 setup 流程登记主机。

howto.what_en: Claude consolidates remote host and session management under the tfx-remote command group: register/edit/diagnose hosts, create/list/attach/send/resume/kill sessions, and probe SSH, Tailscale, and Claude connectivity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to register or diagnose a remote host, create or resume a remote session, or send a follow-up message to a session.

say_en.text: Use tfx-remote spawn to create a session on host1
say_en.note: Runs preflight, then creates the session.
Resumes the latest session, or spawns using default_host if none.

say_en.text: tfx-remote setup --add to add a host
say_en.note: Opens the setup flow to register a host.
